scope: Five retained source parents on the northern Linden/Friedrichstrasse corridor; no new geographical coverage.

owners.name: Hungarian Embassy
owners.facts: Adam Sylvester; grey-yellow polygranite with green glazed ceramic details. Two lower representational floors and offices above. Present building, not the demolished earlier embassy.

owners.name: ARD Hauptstadtstudio
owners.facts: Ortner & Ortner, 1999. Refine retained curved Spree frontage with blue glazing, narrow frames and precast joints. Existing authored envelope and equipment remain.

owners.name: Dussmann KulturKaufhaus
owners.facts: Friedrichstrasse 90; visible street frontage is west of the retained source building, not the east-facing party wall used by its older profile. Repeated upper windows, red facade accents, lower glass arcades and DUSSMANN lettering follow the credited street photo.

owners.name: Helene-Weber-Haus
owners.facts: Bundestag building Dorotheenstrasse 88; source-bound streetfront bands and muted stone framing. Exact aperture dimensions and palette are display estimates.

owners.name: Neustaedtische Kirchstrasse 15
owners.facts: Seat of the Parliamentary Commissioner for the Armed Forces. Source-bound streetfront bands and restrained window framing; no claim to an architectural survey.

estimates: LoD2 wall/roof rings and datum are measured. Fine pane counts/subdivisions, colour values, ceramic widths, joints, sign dimensions, flag dimensions and night-lit selection are source-guided display estimates. No interior survey or new navigation barriers. Native fittings are proportionate axis-aligned readings fitted outside both retained raster layers.
